sloka: स्वयम् प्रकृति सम्पन्नो युयुत्सू राम रावणः ।उत्थितः च अप्रमत्तः च बलानाम् अनुदर्शने ॥६-३-१९॥।।
transliteration: svayam prakṛti sampanno yuyutsū rāma rāvaṇaḥ ।utthitaḥ ca apramattaḥ ca balānām anudarśane ॥6-3-19॥।।

translations.english: "O Rama Ravana, who is hostile in his intentions, assuming his natural tendency which is eagerness to combat, is always very alert and looks after the army."
